BOOK ONE · LESSON 118

What were you doing? 你那时正在做什么？

你那时正在做什么？

A picture lesson introducing the past continuous and past simple in 'when'/'while'/'just as' clauses. Six pictures (m-r) show an action in progress interrupted by a shorter action. The written exercises model 'What were you doing when he arrived?' and 'What was he doing while you were cooking the dinner?'. The grammar workbook drills choosing between the past simple and past continuous, and completing open-ended sentences with while/when/just as.

118 / 144 LESSONS3 PARTSREAD · WRITE · PRACTISE
01

READ & UNDERSTAND

Lesson 课文

Listen and answer the questions. 听录音并回答问题。

听录音并回答问题。

Six pictures (m-r) illustrating past continuous + past simple in when/while/just as clauses. m: Someone knocked at the door when I was having breakfast. n: When I was leaving the house, the postman arrived. o: Just as I was opening the front door, the telephone rang. p: She slipped and hurt herself while she was getting off the bus. q: A man shaving in the mirror. r: A woman cooking the dinner while a man is standing in the rain outside.

六张图片（m-r）展示 when/while/just as 从句中过去进行时代替一般过去时的用法。m 我正吃早饭时，有人敲门。n 我正要出门时，邮递员到了。o 我刚要打开前门，电话就响了。p 她下公共汽车时滑倒了，伤了自己。q 一个男人在镜子里刮脸。r 一个女人在做晚饭，男人在外面的雨里站着。

Listen and answer the questions (pictures m-r)

Listen to the recording and answer the question for each picture (m-r).

听录音并回答每组图片（m-r）的问题。

The recording reads each caption; the answer is the caption sentence itself.
